resources.string: Start with Google to send a postcard or open one addressed to you.
Already here? Sign in with a passkey
Use your existing Remanence key to return to your postcards.
This is how people find you on Remanence.
Choose where to save your key. Then we’ll check whether its provider can protect your postcards.
You will need a passkey provider that supports encrypted account recovery. Saving the key is the first step; verification checks that it can protect your memories.
Select that same key to check protection and finish setup.
Saved in your passkey provider. Verification is still needed before your memories are ready.
Trying again uses the saved key. It does not create another.
The passkey provider may have saved your key, but confirmation did not finish. Check setup before continuing; do not create another key.
Once you send a postcard, its delivery and opening details will appear here.
Choose what you share to improve Remanence
Your saved key stays in its provider. Return with the same Google account to check setup. If saving was not confirmed, you may need help to continue.
